metadata.question: Did Victoria and Corpus Christi, Texas receive less than 20 inches of rainfall between June 15 and June 22, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need rainfall estimates over a 7-day window (15-22 June 2018). - CHIRPS Daily or IMERG will provide daily rainfall. - We need to sum rainfall over the 8 days and compare against 20 inches at two Point geometries in south Texas. - CHIRPS passes through GEE, is rain-only (no cloud mask needed). 2. Masking: - None for CHIRPS Daily; just filter by date and sum. 3. Handling null/zero: - ReduceRegion with sum; the total rainfall across the grid cell(s) is the value we compare. - No pixels indicates no data (unlikely with CHIRPS) – 0 pixels valid would be “C2”. - If the result is None/NaN we will label “C3”, otherwise compare to 20 inches. - Scale: use at least 5000m to stay within quota. import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # Geometry definition pt1 = ee.Geometry.Point(-97.0036, 28.8053) # Victoria, TX pt2 = ee.Geometry.Point(-97.3964, 27.8006) # Corpus Christi, TX start, end = '2018-06-15', '2018-06-22' # Acquire CHIRPS rainfall rain = (ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(start, end) .select('precipitation')) if rain.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No CHIRPS data found.") print("C1") # Sum rainfall across the 7-day collection total = rain.sum() # Calculate totals r1 = total.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.first(), geometry=pt1, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9).get('precipitation').getInfo() r2 = total.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.first(), geometry=pt2, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9).get('precipitation').getInfo() if r1 is None or r2 is None: print("C3") print("Victoria 2018-06-15 to 22 total rain (mm): {:.1f}".format(r1)) print("Corpus Christi 2018-06-15 to 22 total rain (mm): {:.1f}".format(r2)) below20 = (r1/25.4 < 20) and (r2/25.4 < 20) print("A" if below20 else "B")
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# Geometry definition
pt1 = ee.Geometry.Point(-97.0036, 28.8053)     # Victoria, TX
pt2 = ee.Geometry.Point(-97.3964, 27.8006)     # Corpus Christi, TX
start, end = '2018-06-15', '2018-06-22'

# Acquire CHIRPS rainfall
rain = (ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')
          .filterDate(start, end)
          .select('precipitation'))
if rain.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No CHIRPS data found.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

# Sum rainfall across the 7-day collection
total = rain.sum()

# Calculate totals
r1 = total.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.first(),
                        geometry=pt1, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9).get('precipitation').getInfo()
r2 = total.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.first(),
                        geometry=pt2, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9).get('precipitation').getInfo()

if r1 is None or r2 is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
print("Victoria 2018-06-15 to 22 total rain (mm): {:.1f}".format(r1))
print("Corpus Christi 2018-06-15 to 22 total rain (mm): {:.1f}".format(r2))

below20 = (r1/25.4 < 20) and (r2/25.4 < 20)
print("<answer>A</answer>" if below20 else "<answer>B</answer>")
</answer>
